check: describe command('d=$(( $(date +%s) / 86400 )); awk -v d="$d" \'BEGIN{FS=":"}($3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $3+0>d){c++} END{print c?"ko":"ok"}\' /etc/shadow') do

remediation.command:
d=$(( $(date +%s) / 86400 )); awk -F: -v d="$d" '($3 ~ /^[0-9]+$/ && $3+0>d){print $1}' /etc/shadow
# for each listed user: chage -d $(date +%F) <user>   (set last change to today)
remediation.reason: a future last-change date is per-user, fix each with chage after review

title.en: Ensure all users last password change date is in the past
title.fr: Vérifier que la date du dernier changement de mot de passe est dans le passé pour tous les utilisateurs

rationale.en: If a user recorded password change date is in the future then they could bypass any set password expiration.
rationale.fr: If a user recorded password change date is in the future then they could bypass any set password expiration.
